699:             elif a_shape.signed and b_shape.signed:

701:                 return signed(max(a_shape.width, b_shape.width))
702:             elif not a_shape.signed and b_shape.signed:

704:                 return signed(max(a_shape.width + 1, b_shape.width))
705:             else:

707:                 return signed(max(a_shape.width, b_shape.width + 1))

709:         op_shapes = list(map(lambda x: x.shape(), self.operands))
710:         if len(op_shapes) == 1:
711:             a_shape, = op_shapes
712:             if self.operator in ("+", "~"):
713:                 return Shape(a_shape.width, a_shape.signed)
714:             if self.operator == "-":
715:                 return Shape(a_shape.width + 1, True)
716:             if self.operator in ("b", "r|", "r&", "r^"):
717:                 return Shape(1, False)
718:             if self.operator == "u":
